english.title: Driver of vehicle exceed daily 10 hour driving limit - AETR
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), drove a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), when the period of time that the vehicle was driven exceeded the daily limit of driving of ten hours, namely **(..SPECIFY THE DRIVING PERIOD..), in contravention of Article 6.1 of the European Agreement Concerning the Work of Crews of Vehicles Engaged in International Road Transport
english.legislation: Contrary to section 96(11A) of the Transport Act 1968.
